mechanicalMeaning: Synexia source names are donor/reference names; M3JDK uses its own M3 names and preserves semantics/structure rather than copying identifiers blindly.
Synexia com.synexia.indexstring.MIndexString maps to the M3JDK internal java.lang.M3String counterpart.
The M3JDK java.lang.String representation is defined in terms of its internal M3String value owner rather than an optional MIndex sidecar.
M3String preserves the donor owner+coordinate model; per-value byte arrays, char arrays, segment arrays and offset/end arrays are not canonical M3String payload.
All M3JDK precompute facts, tables, caches, images and prepared plans are internal implementation details and are not part of java.lang.String or other public JDK API contracts.
Precompute reuse is bound to exact M3 owner/identity plus range/composition coordinates and cannot alias across owners merely by numeric ID or equal text.
Derived precompute never becomes a second text payload and absence of precompute cannot alter exact Java String semantics.
JNI/native byte[], char[], UTF-8 and UTF-16 representations are shadows materialized from M3String and are never retained as canonical String/M3String storage.
M3JDK internal precompute owners may use compact M3 names; donor class names are provenance/mapping evidence, not target ABI requirements.
M3JDK ports regex term-FST and reasoning mechanics from Synexia-owned implementations and preserves target M3 naming; external donor libraries are provenance only.
java.base and jdk.internal.mindex may not depend at runtime on RE2/J Lucene Tweety or expose their types in signatures.
M3RegexAutomaton is bounded deterministic UTF-16 precompute; unsupported non-regular/out-of-subset syntax fails closed and exact JDK semantics remain authoritative.
M3TermFst is an immutable minimal acyclic UTF-16 term image owned by M3JDK; it is not Lucene serialization or API.
M3ReasoningProgram and M3ReasoningClosure use the Synexia-owned finite grammar and fixed-point semantics; no third-party reasoner owns target semantics.
Regex automata term dictionaries reasoning closure and future donor-inspired facts are internal derived metadata and never canonical String payload or public String API.
M3JDK String promotion requires an explicit Synexia history-recovery ledger; the current donor snapshot alone is not the capability superset.
A historical MIndexString class or atom missing from current Synexia cannot be silently deleted from the target responsibility set.
M3JDK adapts historical ownership/semantics into the smallest faithful M3 target graph; donor wrapper names do not define target ABI.
Historical semantic/index/reasoning or length-proportional facts require a concrete JDK consumer and bounded owner; otherwise they remain donor or external M3-plane evidence.

Only regex expressions with no backslash/metacharacter and replacements with no backslash/group marker may use the canonical M3 literal replacement route; Pattern/Matcher remains authority for all other syntax.
